active.title: AI-native security research to customer-inspectable portfolio
active.problem: THE WORLD has growing AI engineering and security capability, but the highest-value AI-security research must convert continuously into reproducible artifacts that a customer can inspect, rerun and understand.
active.hypothesis: Making AI-native security portfolio conversion the highest-priority R&D mission, with hourly research outputs, defensive adversarial review, bounded Senju improvement and independent evidence gates, will produce stronger reusable Standment security artifacts than optimizing internal activity volume.
active.commercial_bridge: Primary target: reusable Standment AI-security artifacts such as agent permission labs, LLM security eval harnesses, auditability evidence packs and before/after defensive case studies. Senju improves research-process quality only; technical scores never establish buyer demand, contracts, payments or revenue.

active.title: Reliable Standment Security portfolio evidence cycle
active.problem: Standment security R&D can produce technical work without consistently converting it into reproducible, human-inspectable portfolio evidence. The research process must optimize for verified deliverables, counterevidence and repeatability rather than activity volume.
active.hypothesis: A bounded portfolio-first research gate that requires verification evidence, counterevidence and reproducibility will improve the efficiency and stability of converting repeated R&D cycles into credible Standment Security portfolio artifacts.
active.commercial_bridge: Use Senju evidence to improve research-process quality only. A portfolio promotion still requires a human-inspectable artifact, verification proof and explicit limitations. Technical scores do not establish buyer demand, contracts, payments or revenue.

active.title: THE WORLD portfolio proof-to-artifact conversion
active.problem: THE WORLD can generate large amounts of internal research while too little of it becomes a human-inspectable, evidence-backed portfolio artifact that an owner, buyer, or operator can actually judge.
active.hypothesis: Making portfolio conversion the highest-priority general research question across THE WORLD, continuously advancing material proof gaps, and coupling the hardest gap to bounded Senju technical improvement will increase the rate at which BUILDING/EXPERIMENT outputs become genuinely VERIFIED without increasing reporting noise.
active.commercial_bridge: The general portfolio program exists to turn verified R&D output into something a human can inspect, understand, evaluate, sell, or reuse. Standment AI Security remains the current top-priority specialization. Senju technical evidence may strengthen proof quality but must not be treated as willingness-to-pay, market validation, contract value, payment, or revenue.

active.title: Seed-robust Senju champion selection
active.problem: A strategy can look strong in one tournament yet fail multi-seed stability, slowing safe autonomous promotion.
active.hypothesis: A bounded multi-candidate league plus unseen holdout selection will produce more stable champions than single-candidate promotion.
active.commercial_bridge: If repeatedly verified, package the stability and quality-control method as evidence of reliable AI operations. Technical evidence alone does not establish buyer demand.
